title: Gemini 3.6 Flash was linked with updated Flash model variants
summary: On 2026-07-22, the record linked an official Google Blog Gemini-models page whose URL identifies Gemini 3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, and Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber. It also linked an AI Studio new-chat URL configured for Gemini 3.6 Flash, establishing a contemporaneous model-selection reference. The supplied evidence does not establish launch details, capabilities, regions, or terms, so none are stated here.
research_notes: Связанная страница Google от 2026-07-21 представила Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite и ограниченный пилот 3.5 Flash Cyber; 3.6 и 3.5 Flash-Lite стали доступны через Gemini API и AI Studio.
